task.title: Using USB Flash Drive Mode (Audio Inputs)
task.shortdesc: Using USB Flash Mode allows you to play downloaded music through a thumb drive in your car without needing to use a mobile device. The transmiter will read the music files and broadcast them over your car's radio

context.p: To use this mode, you will need to ensure you go through the set-up of the transmitter in your car. Once done, you can quickly begin the steps on using this input option.
